excludedTeams.name: Red Bluff
excludedTeams.reason: Not fielding a varsity team in 2026 (a JV game exists: Red Bluff JV @ Chico, 2026-09-14). MaxPreps lists it as the 7th EAL row at 0-0-0 with modifiedOn null and standingsId all zeros, its 26-27 varsity schedule is empty (data: []) with roster 0 and teamSize 0, and no other team schedules it (the six others play a complete 30-game double round robin among themselves). Red Bluff Daily News 2026-08-22 (https://www.redbluffdailynews.com/2026/08/22/girls-flag-football-is-coming-to-red-bluff/): "a couple from the field hockey program, which will not field a team this fall". Same treatment as Wilcox (SCVAL) and York (PCAL): not in the registry; its names are LEAGUES eal.withdrawnNames and its standings row is eal.maxprepsExtraRows.
excludedTeams.sbliveCaveat: si.com team 490259 (Varsity) still shows placeholder "League" games vs Pleasant Valley (2026-09-08 5:30pm, game 6513038, never resulted; 2026-10-12 5:30pm @ Chico, game 6513168) that do not exist on MaxPreps, and the si.com placeholder team 635037 ("Educational Outreach Academy", Red Bluff) carries its 12 original 2026 EAL fixtures, marked CANC without a score. 490259, 490260 (Red Bluff JV) and 635037 are in DATA_QUALITY.sbliveIgnoredTeamIds.
